description: Defines a custom exception class 'JobInProcessExecution' used to indicate that a job is currently in process during execution. It extends the 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException' to integrate with the application's exception handling framework.

classes.name: JobInProcessExecution
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating that a specific job is currently in execution.

methods.name: JobInProcessExecution
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific identifier, indicating that the job with this identifier is currently in process.
